description: One command installs, configures, starts, updates and reports the single-container instance (provider, port, projects folder, data dir).
fix: P0: `--admin-user/--admin-password` are written to the env file but ignored by the running image; a placeholder `admin` is created and the first password typed claims it. Honour the installer account, or generate a one-time setup token, then test the exact install command. Also make the release build use the release tag instead of a stale `latest`.

description: Guided core first run: add a project, connect an OpenAI-compatible model or skip, setup assistant with preconfigured QA (AI chat once configured), then the project list.
fix: P0 fixed in source for 0.0.1 core: the shell gates on project count and renders WorkspaceWizard, not an empty Top projects screen. The assistant answers from QA until a provider/model is saved. Company wizard remains for --full-featured. Tests: fresh core create -> list -> settings 4xx -> wizard/assistant contract.

description: Username-or-email login, signed session cookie, password change and admin-only account administration.
fix: P0: on a fresh public install the seeded `admin` has no credential and the first password typed becomes the admin password. Require the installer password or a one-time setup token, and force a password change after the first login. (Creating additional users is covered by `multi-user`, hidden in 0.0.1.)

description: Top-level shell that resolves the default workspace, links projects and exposes the project workspace at a stable URL.
fix: Reduce the shell to the 0.0.1 set. The project workspace currently opens the Follow-up task list, not a chat, and its sidebar lists 20+ apps (Harness, Messenger, Meet, Coworking, CISO, Infrastructure, Coder, Desktop, Traefik); make the project the default landing (drop the 'Advanced view' wording) and keep New chat, Tasks, Files, Git and Settings. Hide the other company sections through the feature registry, rename 'Company' to 'Workspace', and fix the duplicate default company (two `ACME`, both `is_default`) plus the `counts.humans = 0` inconsistency.

description: Import an existing folder or clone a Git repository, configure its settings, switch the active project and keep its knowledge fresh.
fix: P0 fixed in source: create_project() calls update_project_snapshot(new_project), so GET /api/projects returns a new project immediately (verified create -> list on a fresh core instance; test api/tests/test_workspace_setup.py). Remaining P1: write .codx/ into .git/info/exclude on creation, create an initial commit and configure the Git identity.

description: Project-aware conversation with the agent: modes, profiles, attachments, streaming, tool calls, cancellation and history.
fix: P0: with no model configured, `POST /api/chats` returns 200 and the user message alone; nothing tells the user the turn never ran. Validate the provider/model before the turn and return `409 model_required` (or render a blocking 'Connect a model' card). Exercise the full turn with a real provider before release.

description: The agent reads and patches files, searches the repo, runs commands/tests, fetches pages and can create tasks or sub-chats.
fix: Not exercised end-to-end without a provider key. Before 0.0.1: verify file read/write/patch, terminal, test run and web fetch against a real model; render every tool call and result in the chat; make destructive commands require confirmation; add a per-turn step limit and a clear failure state.

description: A team of role-specific agents (PM, developer, QA, security) with their own instructions, tools and model; a task picks a role and the shared board carries the handoff.
fix: P1: the built-in team catalogue and per-task profile selection work (verified). Make the role picker obvious in chat/task creation, show the profile on every task card and document the default team (PM, developer, QA, security). Human multi-user teams remain hidden until the create-user flow works.

description: Index the project into embedded LanceDB and retrieve relevant files and documents before the agent answers.
fix: P1: after creating a project the collection is created but stays at `row_count: 0` with 3 files pending; nothing tells the user indexing never started. Pick a working default embeddings model (the image ships the local embeddings stack), start indexing after project creation, and show progress plus a retry/error state.

description: Conversation, live file changes and the running app preview side by side so the user can watch the agent build.
fix: Keep the chat + diff panes; the preview depends on a dev workspace that 0.0.1 hides. Degrade gracefully to a 'start a workspace' link instead of an empty frame, and verify the diff pane refreshes after every tool write.

description: Browse the project tree, open a file read-only and jump to it from a chat reference without leaving the workspace.
fix: P2: verify it is rooted at the project (not the host), hides `.codx`, secrets and binaries, and opens files referenced in chat. Add a large-file guard and a read-only default.

description: The team's shared queue: every card is a task/chat with a role, priority, checklist and the agent run that produced the change.
fix: P1: creating a task succeeds and it appears in `GET /api/tasks`, but `GET /api/tasks/boards` stays empty and a new chat shows up as a task with `status: ""`. Bootstrap a default board/column, normalise the initial status to `todo`, and decide whether a plain chat is a task (the current conflation makes both lists noisy).

description: Branch list, status, staged/unstaged changes, file and PR diffs, commit, pull/push, merge/conflict helpers and GitHub issues.
fix: P0: the first commit fails with 'Author identity unknown' until a Git identity is configured; the wizard never asks for it. P1: `GET /api/git/repo/commits` and `/git/repo/branch/commits` return `[]` while `/git/repo/graph` lists the same commit; fix the commit-list query and add a contract test. Prevent `.codx/` from being committed.

description: Providers, models per purpose, Git identity, environment variables, knowledge options, scripts, preview URL, MCP and per-project permissions.
fix: P1: the global settings endpoints return 500 on a project-less fresh install; make sections independent of the project session. The AI Models screen is the only path to make the product usable and it opens empty with a single 'Add new provider' link; seed a one-click provider preset (DeepSeek/OpenAI) and link to it from the no-model chat. Verify save/reload/history.

description: The FastAPI surface under `/api` (527 documented paths), Socket.IO events and the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
fix: P2: the OpenAPI document is the de-facto contract, but route ordering leaks (`/companies/onboarding` parsed as an id), errors mix 200-with-error and 4xx, and `/api/features` does not exist. Add the feature endpoint, standardise errors, and publish a small, versioned 'core' subset for 0.0.1 instead of advertising every experimental router.

description: Purpose-built phone/tablet shell with a tab bar, launcher and full-screen routes; desktop keeps the sidebar/dockview shell.
fix: Low risk. Re-check the tab bar and launcher after hidden features are removed; they must not link to a hidden section or an empty screen. Add a visual smoke test for one phone viewport.

description: DaisyUI themes, dark/light switching, per-user language and the company-shell translations.
fix: None for 0.0.1. Keep as-is and ensure hidden sections do not leave untranslated nav keys.

description: The model offers likely answers as buttons instead of forcing the user to type.

description: Wallets, spending limits, cxjcoin pricing per model and per-user budgets.
